Remibrutinib Meets Primary Goal
Remibrutinib significantly reduced annualized relapse rates compared with teriflunomide in the REMODEL-1 and REMODEL-2 trials. The oral treatment also reduced inflammatory brain lesions.

Both trials enrolled adults with relapsing multiple sclerosis. The results establish remibrutinib as the first BTK inhibitor to significantly reduce annualized relapse rates across two Phase 3 studies, Novartis said.

A combined analysis also showed a positive trend in three-month confirmed disability progression. In addition, remibrutinib achieved nominal statistical significance in six-month confirmed disability progression.
Novartis Reports No Liver Safety Signal
Novartis said remibrutinib was well tolerated. Its safety profile matched findings from the drug’s wider development program, which includes more than 4,500 clinical trial participants.
